commitMessage:
Add legal consent gate with recorded proof and public legal page

- Terms of use, privacy/location consent (UU PDP), reseller terms and
  open-source attribution (Traccar, Apache 2.0) in one versioned file
- Non-admin users must tick every statement before using the app; the
  version, time, items, role and browser are stored on the user
- Bumping LEGAL_VERSION asks everyone to agree again
- Consent records page for admin/resellers with Excel export
- Public /legal page linked from the login screen
